name: United Club Gymnastics
tagline: For the Love of the Sport.

sources.DG: UCG Design Guide (Build Design Studio, 2026), 91 pages
sources.EDG: UCG Guide to Expressive Design, 9 pages
sources.ORG: Decision by UCG after the guides were delivered (overrides the guides)

core.name: For the Love of the Sport
core.line: Healthy competition fueled by joy, passion, and personal drive.
core.source: ORG (the guides list A Place to Land as core; UCG chose For the Love of the Sport)

supporting.name: A Place to Land
supporting.line: A long-term competitive home beyond traditional gymnastics pathways.

supporting.name: Open Gym
supporting.line: A welcoming competitive space where anyone can belong and participate.

supporting.name: On the Same Team
supporting.line: A culture of camaraderie across competitors, clubs, and communities.

supporting.name: Good Spot
supporting.line: Supportive structure that keeps competition safe, fair, and organized.

tone.name: Welcoming
tone.line: Warm, open, and encouraging. Speak to gymnasts like they already belong.

tone.name: Credible
tone.line: Clear, trusted, and organized. Approachable, but still a governing body.

tone.name: Joyful
tone.line: Energetic, positive, full of life, without becoming unserious.

tone.name: Practical
tone.line: Helpful, direct, easy to follow. People should know exactly what to do next.

facts.description: Nonprofit, fully volunteer-run organization supporting adult club gymnastics, ages 18+
facts.source: DG p73 (check current numbers before publishing)

expressive.note: Not part of the everyday palette. Only for expressive work (merch, social campaigns, event graphics, big-moment collateral). Never for official communications, wayfinding or UI. Only these six: no in-between shades (UCG decision; the guide allowed nearby colors). Text on them: Navy on the first four, White on the last two.

ui_roles.note: UI uses palette colors only. Don't add greys or extra navies.

contrast_policy.rule: All text meets WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text (24px+ regular, or 18.5px+ bold). Icons, logos and other non-text graphics need 3:1. This is stricter than the guides, which approve some pairs that fail; those pairs may still be used for logos and decorative graphics only if they reach 3:1, otherwise not at all.

display.use: Headlines, subheads, big numbers, eyebrow-style labels

body.use: Body copy, buttons and pills, captions, small print

by_surface.web (UCG-owned sites and tools): Greed Condensed + Suisse Intl, self-hosted woff2 from UCG's own domain. Fallback stack Saira Condensed, then Arial.
by_surface.email: Saira Condensed (Google Fonts link, renders in Apple Mail/iOS) falling back to Arial Narrow for headlines; Arial for body.
by_surface.google slides / docs / sheets: Saira Condensed Bold for headlines, Arial for body.
by_surface.print, social graphics, video: Greed Condensed + Suisse Intl (licensed; UCG volunteers making UCG materials only).

typography.buttons: Suisse Intl (or Arial), ALL CAPS, letter-spacing 0.2em. Keep labels short. (DG p76)
typography.lists: 0.5pt dividers between items, 15pt between text and divider, none above the first or below the last item. 30pt between a headline and the list below it. Bullets for unordered items, numbers only for sequences, rankings or counts. (DG p77)
typography.email_signature: Headline Arial Narrow 14pt, name and title Arial 12pt, body Arial 12pt. (DG p37)

list: Color fills: solid brand-color blocks behind type
Strong type: big ALL CAPS condensed headlines
Black-and-white photography with white graphics and type
Engaging photo crops that emphasize the angle and movement of the sport
Rounded corners on cards, panels and photos
Event iconography (MAG, WAG, T&T) and color overlays on photos
design_features.color_overlay_recipe: Black-and-white photo, solid brand color behind it, photo blend mode Screen. (DG p44)

design: Less is more. Present only critical information.
Proper hierarchy: it is read in the order you want.
Brand alignment: it represents what makes UCG unique.
Review for consistency with the design snapshot.
writing: Keep it clear. No jargon or fluff.
Be consistent with the messaging themes and voice.
pre_ship_questions: Is this visually on-brand? Correct logo, colors, fonts, alignment?
Does it sound like UCG? Welcoming, credible, joyful, clear?
Does it honor the people we serve? Gymnasts, clubs and families shown with dignity, respect and belonging?
Is the next step clear? Join, compete, register, volunteer, or connect?
